name: SCGM Bhd
overview: SCGM Bhd 在 2026 年没有录得营收，业务活动主要围绕 PN16 规范化计划展开，包括评估可支持规范化进程的机会。公司于 2026 年 11 月 20 日被 uplift 为现金公司并重新分类行业板块，同时宣布派发每股 25.0 sen 的特别股息。
overview_en: SCGM Bhd recorded no revenue in 2026, with its activities mainly revolving around the PN16 regularization plan, including evaluating opportunities that may support its regularization exercise. The company was uplifted as a cash company and reclassified into a different sector on 20 November 2026, and declared a special dividend of 25.0 sen per share.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司今年没有营收，主要在进行 PN16 规范化计划，并评估可支持规范化进程的机会。
segments.note_en: The company had no revenue this year, focusing on the PN16 regularization plan and evaluating opportunities that may support its regularization exercise.

actions.title: SCGM BHD UPLIFTMENT AS A CASH COMPANY AND RECLASSIFICATION OF SECTOR
actions.text: 公司于 2026 年 11 月 20 日被 uplift 为现金公司并重新分类行业板块。
actions.text_en: The company was uplifted as a cash company and reclassified into a different sector on 20 November 2026.

actions.title: SCGM - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣布派发每股 25.0 sen 的特别股息，除权日为 2026 年 8 月 6 日，支付日为 2026 年 8 月 24 日。
actions.text_en: Declared a special dividend of 25.0 sen per share, with ex-date on 6 August 2026 and payment date on 24 August 2026.

model_changes.title: SCGM BHD UPLIFTMENT AS A CASH COMPANY AND RECLASSIFICATION OF SECTOR
model_changes.text: 公司被 uplift 为现金公司并重新分类行业板块，业务模式转向现金公司状态。
model_changes.text_en: The company was uplifted as a cash company and reclassified into a different sector, shifting its business model to a cash company status.
